LESSON: KITCHEN AND BACKYARD GARDENING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE AND NUTRITION
Strand: FOOD PRODUCTION PROCESSES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested
Topic 2.1: Kitchen and backyard gardening
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Kitchen and backyard gardening, part of FOOD PRODUCTION PROCESSES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 AGRICULTURE AND NUTRITION.

Key inquiry question: How does a kitchen garden contribute to food production?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Kitchen and backyard gardening together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Unity: Collaboration with others while learners establish a kitchen or backyard garden.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Poverty eradication as learners establish their garden to grow own foods.

Link to other subjects: Learners relate growing of own food in kitchen and backyard garden to financial literacy skills learnt

in Pre-technical Studies.
